summary: Frontend-only static single-page test for MeshGrid MY. All 21 required data-testid elements present. Dark theme (#121212) verified. Bilingual EN<->MS toggle works instantly on hero, nav, footer, guide, download cards. Language persists in localStorage 'mg_lang' across reload. All 4 download cards have correct hrefs (play.google, github permissionlesstech/bitchat-android/releases, apps.apple.com bitchat-mesh, github WHITEPAPER.md) with target=_blank. Canvas node map renders (1246x605) with 20 nodes and a live UTC+8 clock. Guide section mentions 919-923 MHz across 4 numbered steps. Nav links and hero CTAs scroll to correct sections. No JS console/page errors. No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: MS nav_map label rendered as 'RANGKAIAN' due to CSS text-transform: uppercase on .nav-links a — expected, not a bug.
Nice-to-have: consider adding rel='noopener noreferrer' (currently only 'noopener') on external cards for stricter security posture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Purely static single-file frontend in /app/frontend/public/index.html. React (#root) renders nothing. All content, i18n dictionary, canvas map and scripts are inline. No backend.
